title: Attaining a fast-conducting, hybrid solid state separator for all solid-state batteries through a facile wet infiltration method
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,1356-1362
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00141B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Philip Heuer, Lukas Ketter, Moumita Rana, Felix Scharf, Gunther Brunklaus, Wolfgang G. Zeier
The fast-conducting Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 is embedded in a polymer matrix and studied via microscopic and electrochemical techniques. Full-cell tests show functionality, supported by resistor network simulations of the hybrid membrane.
